spans.s:
गल् गल्, cl. 1. P. गलति, जगाल, गलिष्-
यति, अगालीत्, गलितुम्, to drip, drop,
ooze, trickle, distil; to fall down or off; to vanish,
perish, pass away; to eat, swallow [cf. 2. गॄ]:
Caus. गालयति, -यितुम्, to cause to drop, to pour
out; to filter, strain; to fuse, liquefy, dissolve, melt:
A. गालयते, to flow; [cf. Old Germ. qvall, quillu,
qual, and quella, ‘a well.’]

गल, अस्, m. the throat, neck; resin, especially
the resin of the plant Shorea Robusta; a kind of
fish, a small kind of Cyprinus, a subgenus of that class
or Cyprinus Garra; a kind of musical instrument;
a reed, a large kind of the Saccharum Cylindricum;
a rope [cf. गल्या]; (आ), f. a kind of plant [cf.
अलम्बुषा; cf. also Lat. collum (?); Germ. hals.]
—गल-कम्बल, अस्, m. a bull's dewlap.
—गल-
गण्ड, औ, m. du. neck and cheek, or neck and
Adam's apple; (अस्), m. enlargement of the
glands of the neck; goitre.
—गलगण्डिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, having a goitre.
—गल-गोलिन्, ई, इनी, m. f. a kind
of serpent.
—गल-ग्रह, अस्, m. seizing by the
throat, throttling, choaking; compression of the
[]
throat, a kind of disease; a fish-sauce prepared with
salt, pepper, ghee, &c.; N. of certain days in the
dark fortnight, viz. the fourth, seventh, eighth, ninth,
thirteenth and three following days; a day on which
a course of study is commenced, but immediately
preceding a day on which study is prohibited; begun
but immediately interrupted study; also गल-ग्र-
हण, अम्, n.
—गल-चर्मन्, अ, n. the gullet,
throat.
—गल-द्वार, अम्, n. the door of the throat,
the mouth.
—गल-मेखला, f. a string of beads worn
round the neck, a necklace.
—गल-वार्त्त, अस्, आ,
अम्, living by eating, a parasite.
—गल-विद्रधि,
इस्, m. tumor and abscess in the throat.
—गल-
व्रत, अस्, m. a peacock; [cf. गर-व्रत.]
—गल-
शुण्डिका, f. the uvula; swelling of the glands of the
neck; (ए), du. the soft palate.
—गल-शुण्डी, f.
swelling of the glands of the neck.
—गल-स्तनी, f.
a she-goat; (a species of the Bengal goat having small
fleshy protuberances, resembling nipples, depending
from the throat); [cf. गले-स्तनी, अजागल-स्तन,
अज-गल्लिका.]
—गल-हस्त, अस्, m. the hand at
the throat, seizing by the throat, collaring, throttling.
—गलहस्तय, nom. P. -तयति, to throttle,
strangle.
—गल-हस्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, seized by the
throat.
—गलाङ्कुर (˚ल-अङ्˚), अस्, m. a disease of
the throat, inflammation of the throat and enlarge-
ment of the tonsils.
—गले-गण्ड, अस्, m. a kind of
bird, the Adjutant or Ardea Argala; (the name
alludes to a pendulous fleshy purse hanging from the
throat of this bird.)
—गले-चोपक, अस्, इका, अम्,
moving the neck.
—गले-स्तनी, f. a she-goat; [cf.
गल-स्तनी.]
—गलोद्भव (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्, m. the
tuft of hair on the neck of a horse.
—गलौघ (˚ल-
ओघ), अस्, m. tumor in the throat.

गल्ल गल्ल, अस्, m. the part of the cheek
near the corners of the mouth; the cheek.
—गल्ल-
चातुरी, f. a small round pillow to put underneath
the cheek.

गाल गाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. गल्), flowing,
liquefying; dropping; a flux.

गाल; add — (अस्, ई, अम्), produced in or from
the throat, guttural.

गलक, अस्, m. the throat, the neck; a kind of
fish, a small kind of Cyprinus.

गलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dropping, falling, oozing,
trickling, flowing; melting.

गलन, अस्, आ, अम्, dropping, flowing; (अम्), n.
dropping, oozing, trickling; melting, fusing; falling
down or off; leaking.

गालन, अम्, n. straining fluids; fusing, lique-
fying, &c.

गलनीय or गलितव्य or गल्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
fusible, soluble, liquefiable, to be melted &c.

गलन्तिका or गलन्ती, f. a small pitcher; a small
water-jar with a hole in the bottom, from which the
water drops upon a Liṅga or upon a Tulasi plant
placed beneath.

गलित, अस्, आ, अम्, dropped, fallen; liquefied,
melted; distilled, oozed, flowing; untied, loosed;
lost, deprived; decayed, impaired.
—गलित-कुष्ठ,
अम्, n. advanced and incurable leprosy, when the
fingers and toes fall off.
—गलित-दन्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the teeth decayed, toothless.
—गलित-नख,
अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having the claws or nails fallen off.
—गलित-नख-दन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has
lost his claws and teeth.
—गलित-नयन, अस्, आ,
अम्, one who has lost his eyes, blind.
—गलित-
प्रदीप, अस्, m. or गलित-प्रदीपिका, f. title of a
work, lit, ‘the light of dropped words,’ i. e. of certain
words in a manuscript which occur several times and
are given only once at full length.

गालित, अस्, आ, अम्, distilled, strained, dropped,
melted, fused.
गलितक, अस्, m. a kind of dance, gesticulation.

गल्या, f. a multitude of throats; a quantity of a
particular kind of grass or of ropes made of it.

गलानिल गलानिल, अस्, m. a prawn or
shrimp; see गङ्गाटेय; (also read गलानिक and
गलाविल.)
गलावल गलावल, अस्, m. a kind of tree.
गलि गलि, इस्, m. a strong but lazy bull.

गालि, इस्, f. a curse, execration or imprecation.
—गालि-प्रदान, अम्, n. cursing, reviling, abusing.
—गालि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, uttering curses or execra-
tions.
गलू गलू, ऊस्, m. a sort of gem.
गलून गलून, अस्, m., N. of a minister.

गलोड्य गलोड्य or गालोड्य, अस्, m. (?), N.
of a plant; [cf. गिलोड्य.]

गालोड्य गालोड्य, अम्, n. the seed of the
lotus; [cf. अङ्कलोड्य, अङ्गलोड्य, गलोड्य, गि-
लोड्य.]

गल्द गल्द, अस्, आ, m. f., Ved. speech;
straining; that which flows from a strainer (?).

गल्भ् गल्भ्, cl. 1. A. गल्भते, to be
bold or confident; [cf. गर्व्; cf. also
Hib. galbha, ‘rigour, hardness.’]
गल्लकी गल्लकी, f., N. of a river.

गल्वर्क गल्वर्क, अस्, m. crystal; lapis
lazuli (?), sapphire (?), emerald (?); a goblet, a vessel
for drinking spirituous liquor.

गल्ह् गल्ह्, cl. 1. A. गल्हते, to blame,
to censure or despise; [cf. गर्ह्.]

गालव, अस्, m. the tree Symplocos Racemosa, the
bark of which is used in dyeing, Lodh; a pale species
of the same, = श्वेत-लोध्र; also a kind of ebony,
Diospyros Glutinosa [cf. केन्दुक]; N. of an old
sage and preceptor, according to the Hari-vaṃśa a son,
and according to the Mahā-bhārata a pupil of Viśvā-
mitra; N. of the author of a Dharma-śāstra; N. of a
grammarian; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Gālava.
गालवि, a patronymic from Gālava.

गालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, distilling, fusing, liquefying; abus-
ing, abusive.

गालिनी, f. a particular gesticulation or position of
the fingers.

गालोडय गालोडय, A. -डयते, -यितुम्, to
examine, investigate.
गालोडित, अम्, n. examination, investigation.
